objective: Minimum selection FPR with recall >=95%; ties higher recall then F1
fallback: If no candidate qualifies, highest recall, then lowest FPR; marked infeasible
cross_validation: StratifiedGroupKFold on calibration, which neither base model fitted; out-of-fold scores calibrate thresholds, then refit meta-model on calibration; selection chooses C and recall target; official test scored after freezing.
